news.title: Trump administration equity stakes pose risks to U.S. companies and markets
news.description: The Trump administration's growing portfolio of direct investments is unprecedented outside an economic crisis or wartime.

news.title: Automakers largely sit out 2026 Super Bowl advertising amid industry uncertainty
news.description: Automakers are largely sitting on the advertising sidelines during this year's Super Bowl amid broader uncertainty in the U.S. automotive industry.

news.title: Pressure mounts on American Airlines CEO as carrier lags rivals
news.description: American Airlines made $111 million last year, while rivals Delta Air Lines and United Airlines, brought in $5 billion and $3.3 billion, respectively.
